# T-1: Persist merge metadata

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add a finalize helper and pre-hook wiring that commits current-spec flow metadata before pre-merge rebase only when all dirty paths are allowed metadata paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The allowed path set is exactly specs/<specId>/flow.json and specs/<specId>/issue-log.json.
- The helper creates a commit when at least one allowed path is dirty and no target-external path is dirty.
- The helper returns without committing when any target-external dirty path exists.
- The pre hook does not run downstream skipped reset when any target-external dirty path exists.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a helper in src/flow/lib/run-finalize.js so registry.js stays declarative. Reuse runGit and commitOrSkip. Check target-external dirty paths before running downstream skipped reset, so reset mutation is skipped when user work is dirty.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests should create temporary git repos and assert commit path contents and dirty status outcomes.
